description: Hi! Welcome to PollenSense! We are building a smart early warning system using NASA Earth data (MODIS/Landsat & GEOS-5) to predict seasonal allergy risks and improve public health. We are looking for motivated teammates passionate about research, design, or data. Join us to build an impactful project together!
summary: PollenSense is an innovative, interactive digital health platform that bridges the gap between NASA Earth-observation data and personal respiratory well-being. We developed a smart web platform that integrates four core NASA satellite datasets—MODIS for vegetation blooming, SMAP for soil moisture, MERRA-2 for wind patterns, and Landsat for spatial mapping—combined with personalized user health profiles. Instead of relying on generic weather forecasts, PollenSense addresses the challenge by transforming raw environmental data into a real-time predictive risk index, issuing proactive early warnings for pollen waves and dust storms tailored to each user's specific medical condition, such as asthma or allergies, alongside an Actionable Health and Exposure Protocol offering practical daily instructions on outdoor timing, respiratory protection, and indoor air filtration. This solution is vital because millions of people, especially children and students, face unpredictable and life-disrupting respiratory attacks, and PollenSense empowers communities to anticipate environmental hazards before exposure, preventing sudden health crises and making daily life safer.
details:
What it does & How it works:

PollenSense is a smart digital platform designed to protect respiratory health by bridging the gap between NASA Earth-observation data and personalized preventive care. The platform integrates multiple NASA datasets—including MODIS (vegetation and blooming indices), SMAP (soil moisture for dust risk), MERRA-2 (wind speed and dispersion), and Landsat (high-resolution spatial mapping)—to calculate real-time, localized risk indices for pollen waves and dust storms. Users select their specific health profile (such as chronic asthma, seasonal allergies, or dust sensitivity) to receive tailored, actionable exposure protocols and early warnings.

Benefits & Intended Impact:

By translating complex satellite data into simple, personalized daily guidance, PollenSense empowers vulnerable individuals to proactively manage their outdoor activities, reduce acute respiratory attacks, and minimize emergency hospital visits.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software:

The interactive web prototype was developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, utilizing responsive UI design principles alongside NASA Earth Science data frameworks.

Creativity & Key Factors Considered:

Unlike generic weather or air-quality apps that display raw numbers, PollenSense's creativity lies in its user-centric "Actionable Exposure Protocol" engine, which dynamically adapts environmental satellite telemetry to individual medical sensitivities while considering accessibility, mobile responsiveness, and real-time decision-making speed.
